Class GraphDesk

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.lcarsgraph.GraphDesk
public final class GraphDesk extends Object
Each login keeps one graph. A different login keeps a different pane and a different model.

    • hold

      public static void hold(String username)
      The method marks a vault seat as on the way. The event thread calls this before the vault thread borrows. A walk that arrives early waits for that seat.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.

    • model

      public static void model(String username, Runnable job)
      The method runs one job on the model thread. The event thread returns. A call already on the model thread runs the job in line.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.
      job - The job reads turns, parses, or applies. It may be null.

    • vault

      public static void vault(String username, Runnable job)
      The method runs one job on the vault thread. The event thread returns. A call already on the vault thread runs the job in line.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.
      job - The job borrows, reads, or writes. It may be null.

    • place

      static void place(GraphPane pane, Runnable job)
      The method runs one settle on the picture thread. A pane that is not seated still leaves the event thread. A call already on the picture thread runs the job in line.
      Parameters:
      pane - The pane that owns the picture.
      job - The job places and then posts a paint.

    • seat

      public static void seat(String username, Connection connection, String canvasId)
      The method seats the open connection and the focused canvas for one login. A load runs when that login already has a pane and the canvas changed. The event thread enqueues the load and returns. A null connection releases the hold and does not borrow. The shelf stays keyed by username.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.
      connection - The connection the vault already opened.
      canvasId - The canvas that owns the rows.

    • hydrate

      public static void hydrate(String username, List<GraphTurn> turns, GraphDoor door)
      The method fills an empty graph from the conversation. A model that already holds an aim returns. A model whose every intent is the map phrase is cleared and asked. A pass already in flight returns. The ask runs on the model thread. The first turn is fresh. Each later turn is its own ask. Each passing turn is saved on the vault thread. The picture thread measures that turn. The event thread paints the measured size. The picture paints before the next ask.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.
      turns - The turns are the conversation, oldest first.
      door - The door sends one brief.

    • reload

      public static void reload(String username, List<GraphTurn> turns, GraphDoor door)
      The method clears this login's graph and infers the conversation again. A held aim does not stop the walk. Pins, rejects, and feed rows for that canvas go with the clear. A pass already in flight returns. An empty conversation clears the graph and does not ask. The ask runs on the model thread. The first turn is fresh. Each later turn is its own ask. Each passing turn is saved on the vault thread. The picture thread measures that turn. The event thread paints the measured size. The picture paints before the next ask.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.
      turns - The turns are the conversation, oldest first.
      door - The door sends one brief.

    • zero

      public static void zero(String username, String canvasId, Connection fallback)
      The method zeros one canvas graph and arms the per-turn cycle. The model for that canvas is vacated. The vault rows for that canvas go. A walk already in flight finishes its current ask and does not paint over the zero. The next sealed turn on that canvas is opening fresh. Each later sealed turn is opening turn. A null fallback is closed only when the seat has no connection of its own.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.
      canvasId - The canvas whose graph goes.
      fallback - A connection to use when that login has no seated connection. It may be null.

    • zero

      public static void zero(String username, String canvasId)
      The method zeros one canvas graph and arms the per-turn cycle. The seated connection deletes the rows. A login with no seat only vacates a showing model.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.
      canvasId - The canvas whose graph goes.

    • grow

      public static void grow(String username, List<GraphTurn> turns, GraphDoor door)
      The method folds the newest sealed turns into a graph that Clear Turns armed. A login that was not zeroed returns. A different canvas returns. An empty model walks opening fresh, then opening turn for each later turn. A model that already holds an aim walks opening turn for the newest turn only. The ask runs on the model thread. The import walk is not this method.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.
      turns - The turns are the conversation, oldest first.
      door - The door sends one brief.

    • halt

      public static void halt(String username)
      The method stops the live graph load for one login. The ask already in flight finishes. A later ask does not start. The rendering spinner stops when that walk returns. The three seats stay up. A later reload still asks.
      Parameters:
      username - The login that owns the graph.

    • stop

      static void stop(GraphPane pane)
      The method stops the live graph load for the login that owns the pane. A pane that is not seated returns.
      Parameters:
      pane - The pane is that login's graph.
